content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to retrieve the firmware version using internal software. Based on what I've learned, this value can be accessed either through the [product_name] software via Tools->Transfer->Show FW Version, or through the web interface using the [product_name] system command. Is this information stored in Modbus registers, or are there other methods to obtain it, such as cgi commands? Additionally, is it possible to source other details like device series, type, status, or serial number by similar means? Thanks,

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. From what I know, [company_name] does not make this information available on [product_name]. This device is a basic programmable relay rather than a full-featured PLC. If [company_name] stores such details somewhere, it is not documented in manuals or online resources, and I have not seen any reports in the forum indicating that this data can be accessed programmatically or remotely.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking options to programmatically retrieve firmware version and other device information from [product_name] hardware, ideally using Modbus or alternative methods. The response clarifies that, according to documentation and common practice, accessing this information through software or remote means is not supported. This limitation may hinder advanced diagnostics and automated management for users.
